reference.browser: Unmodified official UMD React TreeSelect with public components.root, actual mouse/keyboard and imperative refs
reference.server: Unmodified ReactDOMServer in DOM-free VM, projected into inert HTML
reference.received: Raw component props are Source-only forensic evidence; no Native implementation is imported. DOM attributes and callbacks are projected independently.
reference.cancellation: Fixture handlers prevent only cancelable events; shared DOM projection preserves raw defaultPrevented without normalizing React SyntheticEvent behavior.
reference.keyboard: Real down and up are separate actions with two animation frames between them, equally in Source and Native, so MessageChannel closes settle before keyup. Earlier unpaced raw captures are retained as scheduling observations.
observations: Custom root drops generated onMouseDown together with the default selector, while original element onMouseDown survives.
Disabled TreeSelect does not disable custom root DOM and still requests open=true on click/Enter; merged popup remains closed and generated focus/blur callbacks are suppressed.
Focus action can open before a physical root click, which then schedules close; both requests are kept raw.
A custom root input is independent text: typing does not call TreeSelect search/change. Composite Input exposes its wrapper as nativeElement and focuses the inner input.
React server rendering suppresses initial open; Native retains its established hidden-shell SSR contract separately.
